entries.name: Event
entries.doc:
Event subscription hub. Subscribe with a reference name; reusing a name on the same event overwrites that subscriber.
Subscribers run in subscription order; names are per-plugin. Some payloads are writeable and changes pass to later subscribers.

```lua
Event.NPCEntityAdded.Subscribe("myRefName", function(e) log("An NPC was added!") end)
Event.NPCEntityAdded.Unsubscribe("myRefName")
```

entries.name: Hook
entries.doc:
Event hooks for `Component:Subscribe`. Callback args after `self`:
- ONBUTTONPRESSED(currentValue: integer, previousValue: integer)
- ONCONTENTCHANGED(reason: ui.InputFieldActionResult, newContents: string)
- ONSELECTIONCHANGED(entryID: integer, selectedStatus: integer) for Carousel/PagedLayer/Slider;
  (entryID: integer, selectionEventType: ui.SelectionChangeEvent) for ComboField/List/RadioGroup;
  (curValue: number, progressPc: number) for RadialProgressOverlay
- ONCUTSCENEFINISHED(reason: ui.CutscenePlaybackEndReason)
- ONCLICK/ONCLICKREPEAT/ONRELEASE/ONHOLD/ONMOUSEOVER/ONMOUSEREPEAT/ONMOUSELEAVE(x: integer, y: integer)
  ONHOLD repeats while the button is held; x/y are the mouse inside the component in interface units.
- ONDRAG(dragStartX, dragStartY); ONDRAGCOMPLETE(dragDestination: ui.Component, dragEndX, dragEndY)
  Not sent to plugin components, even with a dragConfig set (beta 951.1); use ONHOLD to drag.

entries.name: Reflect
entries.doc: Reflects this vector along `normal`. Both should be normalised first.

entries.name: Rotate
entries.doc: Returns this vector rotated by a Quaternion.

entries.name: new
entries.signature: function Vector3.new(x: number, y: number, z: number): Vector3
entries.doc: Creates a Vector3: no args = all 0, one arg = all set to `v`, three args = x, y, z.

entries.name: new
entries.signature: function Vector4.new(x: number, y: number, z: number, w: number): Vector4
entries.doc: Creates a Vector4: no args = all 0, one arg = all `v`, four args = x, y, z, w, or two Vector2s (xy, zw).

entries.name: xy
entries.doc: x, y as a Vector2. Read-only.

entries.name: xyz
entries.doc: x, y, z as a Vector3. Read-only.

entries.name: zw
entries.doc: z, w as a Vector2. Read-only.

entries.name: World
entries.doc: Information about the connected game world.

entries.name: GetGroundHeight
entries.signature: function World.GetGroundHeight(level: integer, x: integer, z: integer, heightOffsetType?: HeightOffsetType): integer, boolean
entries.doc:
Returns the ground height at a position and a success flag. Height is -1 on failure.

*@param* `level` — Level, 0-3.  
*@param* `x` — X in Fine units (512 per tile).  
*@param* `z` — Z in Fine units (512 per tile).

entries.name: GetMapSquareBounds
entries.doc: Returns the bounds of the loaded world in map squares (64x64 tiles each).

entries.name: GetPing
entries.doc: Returns ping to the current world, or -1 with no connection. Internally limited to one request per 5 seconds.

entries.name: GetRebootTimer
entries.doc: Returns logic ticks (50 per second) until server reboot; 0 if unavailable or no reboot is scheduled.

entries.name: GetRegionSourceForCoordGrid
entries.doc:
Returns the bottom-left CoordGrid of the source data for a region coordinate.
Nil if not in a region or the coordinate is outside the region bounds.

entries.name: IsAvailable
entries.doc: Returns whether world data can currently be read.

entries.name: IsMembers
entries.doc: Returns whether the connected world is a Members' world.

entries.name: IsRegion
entries.doc: Returns whether the current world is a region (an Instance in game terms).

entries.name: RemoveRoof
entries.doc:
Selective roof removal. Only takes effect when the Remove Roofs graphics setting is "Selectively".
Entries are owned by the registering plugin and removed when it unloads.

entries.name: Add
entries.doc: Registers a coordinate, or an inclusive coordinate range, under a name. Reusing a name updates the entry.

entries.name: Clear
entries.doc: Removes all Remove Roof entries registered by this plugin.

entries.name: Remove
entries.doc: Removes the entry registered under the given name.
